description: Capture one UI piece central to the feature (a card, a bar, a dialog) from the current page, in its current state. Call again with another state name after changing the app to add states. Returns the component isolated on a transparent background.

isNew.description: New or changed in this feature

target.description: How to find an element: prefer role+name, then text, then selector.

name.description: Accessible name (with role) or a form label (alone)

selector.description: CSS selector, last resort. In a demo step, "@x,y" is a point in the window (CSS px; points on a phone) for a canvas with nothing to target

name: capture_component
title: Capture a component
